title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 9 — WORLD 8: C1+ LAW, GOVERNANCE & CIVIC COMMUNICATION
grammar: Advanced formal register for legal, institutional, and civic communication
Complex qualification, limitation, and exception structures
Modality and obligation for rules, rights, duties, and policy language
Conditional and hypothetical reasoning for institutional scenarios
Passive, impersonal, and agentless structures in formal documents
Nominalisation and information compression in legal and policy writing
Hedging, attribution, and careful treatment of contested claims
Audience and register adaptation for citizens, officials, lawyers, media, and international audiences

missions.title: Civic Language Calibration
missions.focus: Distinguish laws, regulations, policies, institutions, rights, duties, procedures, and public claims using precise C1+ language.

missions.title: Legal Vocabulary Forge
missions.focus: Use advanced vocabulary for courts, contracts, evidence, liability, compliance, disputes, remedies, and legal procedure.

missions.title: Constitution & Institutions Observatory
missions.focus: Explain how public institutions are structured and how formal responsibilities and powers are described.

missions.title: Rights & Responsibilities Lab
missions.focus: Analyse language about individual rights, civic duties, responsibilities, protections, limitations, and competing interests.

missions.title: Law in Context Simulator
missions.focus: Interpret rules and hypothetical cases while distinguishing legal text from interpretation, application, and opinion.

missions.title: Evidence & Argument Courtroom
missions.focus: Evaluate evidence, claims, counterclaims, relevance, uncertainty, and reasoning in a simulated legal argument.

missions.title: Contract Language Decoder
missions.focus: Understand key contractual structures including obligations, conditions, warranties, exceptions, termination, and remedies.

missions.title: Governance Systems Nexus
missions.focus: Discuss transparency, accountability, institutional roles, public administration, oversight, and decision-making processes.

missions.title: Policy Analysis Studio
missions.focus: Analyse a public policy by identifying objectives, affected groups, implementation mechanisms, evidence, trade-offs, and limitations.

missions.title: Regulation & Compliance Mission
missions.focus: Explain regulatory requirements, compliance systems, enforcement, risk management, and organisational responsibilities.

missions.title: International Law Forum
missions.focus: Explore advanced language for treaties, international obligations, cooperation, jurisdiction, and cross-border disputes.

missions.title: Public Administration Problem-Solver
missions.focus: Resolve an institutional case by clarifying procedures, stakeholders, constraints, responsibilities, and possible lawful responses.

missions.title: Civic Media Intelligence
missions.focus: Separate reporting, commentary, official statements, legal claims, and unverified assertions when analysing public information.

missions.title: Public Consultation Arena
missions.focus: Participate in a structured consultation by presenting evidence, asking precise questions, acknowledging competing concerns, and responding respectfully.

missions.title: Formal Legal & Policy Writing
missions.focus: Write a structured policy or legal briefing that defines the issue, summarises evidence, explains implications, and qualifies uncertainty.

missions.title: Mediation & Dispute Resolution
missions.focus: Use diplomatic and legally appropriate language to clarify interests, propose settlements, manage disagreement, and record agreements.

missions.title: Civic Presentation Command
missions.focus: Deliver an audience-aware presentation explaining a complex institutional or policy issue clearly without overstating evidence.

missions.title: Governance Crisis Simulation
missions.focus: Manage a simulated institutional crisis through accurate public communication, stakeholder coordination, procedural reasoning, and accountability language.

missions.title: World 8 Integration Quest
missions.focus: Integrate legal reading, institutional listening, evidence analysis, policy writing, mediation, civic discussion, and formal presentation.

missions.title: C1+ Law, Governance & Civic Master Challenge
missions.focus: Complete an integrated civic scenario using precise legal vocabulary, evidence-based reasoning, careful qualification, and strategic communication.

realWorldScenarios.title: Policy Consultation Chamber
realWorldScenarios.description: Review a proposed public policy, identify evidence and trade-offs, prepare questions, and present a balanced stakeholder response.

realWorldScenarios.title: Contract & Dispute Resolution Desk
realWorldScenarios.description: Analyse a simulated contract dispute, identify relevant obligations and uncertainties, and conduct a structured mediation.

realWorldScenarios.title: International Governance Briefing
realWorldScenarios.description: Prepare a formal briefing on an international institutional issue, explaining responsibilities, competing interests, evidence, and possible cooperative responses.
